name: rundrill-system-design
description: System-design coach — learn to design distributed systems and prep for the FAANG system design interview by reviewing flawed designs, defending tradeoffs, and running mock interviews, with drills, progress, and mistake memory, inside your AI agent.

interface.shortDescription: System-design coach: review flawed designs, defend tradeoffs, run mock interviews.
interface.longDescription: An interactive system-design coach for both genuine understanding of distributed systems and the FAANG system design interview. Climbs a five-level ladder — Foundations (scale, CAP, networking) → Components (databases, caches, queues, CDNs) → Patterns (sharding, consistency, idempotency, rate limiting) → Systems (design Twitter, Uber, WhatsApp, payments end-to-end) → Interview (the framework, estimation, leveling). There's no compiler and no single right answer, so the drills train reasoning: the signature drill hands you a plausible-but-flawed design and asks you to find the planted SPOF, hotspot, or wrong tradeoff (like reviewing an AI's design); plus commit-then-defend tradeoff drills, back-of-envelope estimation, predict-the-failure-mode, and full mock interviews graded on the four interviewer dimensions with a level read (E4/E5/E6+). Backed by the RunDrill MCP engine with progress tracking and mistake memory. Pick your goal: learn system design, or prep for the interview.
defaultPrompt: Start a system design drill session.
Show me a design and let me find what's wrong with it.
Run a mock system design interview with me.
